Georgia.focus: GREAT Health: AHEAD readiness, continuum of care, access and workforce
Georgia.description: Georgia's Rural Enhancement And Transformation of Health (GREAT Health) program pursues all five RHT goals through five initiatives, starting with preparing rural providers to qualify for CMS's AHEAD Model.
initiatives: Transforming for a Sustainable Health System
Readiness assessments and technical assistance so rural hospitals and primary care can qualify for AHEAD.
Strengthening the Continuum of Care
Nine strategies on rural behavioral health, emergency preparedness, newborn screening, interhospital transport and brain-injury support.
Connecting to Care to Improve Healthcare Access
Six strategies to expand access to care in rural places.

Hawaii.focus: Six initiatives from a statewide digital backbone to AHEAD readiness
Hawaii.description: Hawaii, where 95.1% of land is rural and services center on Honolulu, plans six interconnected initiatives addressing health IT, EMS, behavioral health, workforce and innovative care models.
initiatives: Rural Health Information Network
A statewide digital backbone connecting rural hospitals, clinics and health centers through interoperable EHRs and data hubs.
Pili Ola Telehealth Network
A statewide telehealth network with virtual care and telehealth training.
Rural Infrastructure for Care Access
Expanded EMS, community paramedicine, mobile care and behavioral health infrastructure.
HOME RUN and Rural Respite Network
Workforce pipeline programs, and medical respite for unhoused or post-acute patients in rural areas.

Idaho.focus: Technology, innovative care models, workforce and chronic disease prevention
Idaho.description: Idaho plans to turn fragmented rural health care infrastructure into a resilient, patient-centered system through five coordinated initiatives shaped by public priorities: workforce, access and chronic disease prevention.
initiatives: Rural access through technology
Telehealth, EHR interoperability, AI, cybersecurity, emergency communications and data analytics.
Innovative care models
Health extenders such as CHWs, community EMS and pharmacy professionals; stronger EMS; home- and community-based care.
Rural workforce
Ladder payments, scholarships, training pathways and residencies, with a five-year rural service commitment.

Illinois.focus: Transforming rural care, overcoming distance, building the workforce
Illinois.description: Illinois's plan, led by the Department of Healthcare and Family Services, groups its initiatives into three categories aimed at right-sizing rural care, bringing care into communities and building a local workforce.
initiatives: Transforming Rural Healthcare
Hospital transformation, community care infrastructure and hospital-based disease prevention.
Overcoming Geographic Barriers to Care
EMS and mobile healthcare, and technology for virtual care.
Building a Resilient Rural Workforce
Workforce expansion, training for health support workers and a rural health education pipeline.

Indiana.focus: GROW: 12 initiatives across the five CMS goals
Indiana.description: Indiana's GROW program extends its Make Indiana Healthy Again initiatives with 12 target initiatives that balance statewide efforts with regionally designed projects.
initiatives: Sustainable Access
A statewide Medical Organizations Coordination Center and an enhanced Indiana 211 for closed-loop referrals.
Tech Innovation
Interoperability networks connecting rural facilities.
Innovative Care
Pediatric and obstetric emergency readiness, cardiometabolic care standards, medication access, tele-consult and telehealth.
Workforce Development
Credentialing and training for CHWs and peers, physician stipends and rural preceptorships.
